description.zh: 从TDD方法论指导到自动生成单元测试代码、跨语言测试编写与运行、Playwright/Cypress E2E测试编排、REST/GraphQL API测试自动化，再到QA测试计划与覆盖率矩阵生成的完整自动化测试工作流。支持Python(pytest)、JavaScript(Jest/Vitest/Mocha)、Go等多语言，覆盖单元测试、集成测试、E2E测试、API测试和性能测试。
description.en: End-to-end software test automation workflow covering TDD strategy, generated unit tests, multi-language test suites, Playwright/Cypress E2E automation, REST and GraphQL API testing, QA planning, coverage matrices, release checklists, and quality dashboards.
